title: A draft PR that no live session owns and no doing step names closes as stale
why: The open-PR count was 763 at 21:00 CST Nov 9; the owner wants it down to live work (owner chat 21:27 and 21:29 CST: "the amt of open prs we have now is not best practices"). CORRECTED 17:26 CST Nov 14 (Explore agent on Sonnet, REST reads, 17:12 CST; triage read no PR; replaces the earlier "170 draft PRs over 12 hours" line from the 16:34 CST Status tab republish): the real stale set is 541 open drafts created more than 12 h before 17:12 CST, #1034 to #3396. The 170 was only the band #3111 to #3396 (179 drafts there: 9 LIVE, 170 UNKNOWN). Counts, all 541: LIVE 10 (#3005, #3212, #3223, #3250, #3251, #3253, #3285, #3318, #3391, #3396), REPLACED 3 (#1552 by merged #3010, #1844 by merged #3104, #2680 by merged #3404 by chain through #3272 and #3403; the replacement is merged by REST; titles differ), LIVE-REPLACEMENT 20 (the replacer is open: #1386, #1708, #1760, #1784, #1789, #1938, #2083, #2197, #2226, #2463, #2677, #2740, #2771, #2797, #2826, #2892; partial: #1616, #1618, #1748, #2763), UNKNOWN 508. The coordinator's 13 REPLACED are already closed (17:13 CST list; none is an open candidate). Nothing closed; closing is the batch runner's act (ruling pr-close-by-batch-runner) on the coordinator's order. Best source for the 508: draft #3154 (backlog-drain ledger) docs/backlog-drain/verdicts.tsv (keep/rebuild/close, 234 PRs) and part3-subsumed.tsv (71 subsumed in a stack), both unread. Leads: #2820, #2837, #2838, #3175, #3240 and #3260 carry a batch-runner "Closed by..." comment yet are open (no merged replacer: unknown); 61 carry "Reopened: closed unmerged in an unexplained bulk loop; backlog-drain sorts it"; combined PRs #3331, #3332, #3333 and #3368 name stale PRs in their bodies (28, 41, 2, 8). Next sort offered to the coordinator at 17:25 CST (read the #3154 ledger against the 508, read-only); waiting for its go. The page file and build upkeep line still say 170 until the next republish.. Build caveats: the page file is 14.0 MB of the 16 MB cap; PR rows carry no head shas, so rows that read a head show unknown; 2067 session rows carried unverified, so the build's 384 stalled-step lines are unknown; the build's hint "set to done: landed in #..." for records-page-before-ready is wrong (#3396 and #3426 are open).
note: Starts after close-replaced-at-open. Goal: open PRs are live work only. Test: no live (unarchived) session owns the draft PR, and no step marked doing names it. Then it closes as stale with a comment that names why; its branch stays, and it reopens on need. The first pass is a preview list for the coordinator's read before any close. Filed from coordinator 21:34 CST, corrected 21:35 CST (dropped a 7-day no-commit test as an unmeasured fixed value).
